note: Aggregates are reproduced directly from the per-question result files locomo_memory_results_{A0B0,A1B0,A1B1}.json. Toggles: A = transcript_ingest (ITM_TRANSCRIPT_INGEST), B = spreading_debias_enabled (ITM_DEBIAS). Both default OFF in itm/config.py.

refusal_hardened_rescoring.description: A refusal ('Not mentioned') on an answerable question is forced to 0 before averaging. Slope on answerable cats 1-4.

independent_judge_gpt_4_1_mini.description: A paired 200-question stratified subsample (conv-41, conv-42; the conversations present in all three result files) was re-graded with gpt-4.1-mini on the SAME stored predictions. See rejudge_mini_subsample.json. The improvement direction (baseline < +A+B) is preserved; the mini judge is more lenient on the baseline (it credits some refusal-adjacent predictions), which compresses the slope on this small slice.

ceiling.answer_model_bottleneck: Even when gold evidence IS in the recalled top-5 context, gpt-4.1-nano answers correctly only ~37.6% of the time (answerable_judge_when_gold_present at A1B1). ITM's contribution is retrieving the right evidence (gold-in-top5: 5.3% -> 41.3% -> 65.6%), not reasoning over it.
ceiling.abstention_cost: Better recall costs a few points of appropriate abstention on adversarial trap questions: adversarial judge 0.9798 -> 0.8969 -> 0.8565.
ceiling.top_k: top_k=5 is a lower bound on retrieval; larger k was not swept here.
ceiling.caveat: Single seed, no error bars. This is a relative-improvement ablation, NOT a SOTA-competitive absolute accuracy.
